words.enExample: She inquired about the opening hours.
words.zhExample: 她打听了一下营业时间。
words.note: in-（入）+ quir（问，同 question）→ 问进去。正式场合常用，比 ask 更书面。高频搭配：inquire about / into。近义 ask；反义 reply。注意拼写 inquire（美），enquiry（英，名词）。
名词 venture 是「冒险事业」（business venture）。作动词常接 opinion / question / guess，表示「小心翼翼地开口」。近义 dare；反义 hesitate（犹豫）。经典句型：venture to say（冒昧地说）。
形容紧张或慌乱时说话卡顿。近义 stutter（更偏生理口吃）；区别：stammer 多因情绪。搭配 stammer out（结巴着说出）。反义 articulate（清晰表达）。

words.enExample: The phrasing made all the difference.
words.note: phrase（短语/措辞）+ -ing。指「怎么把话说出口」，商务沟通里很关键。搭配 careful phrasing（谨慎的措辞）。近义 wording；相关：rephrase（换个说法）。
来自 poise（平衡/姿态）。形容人「临危不乱、姿态稳」。也用于 be poised to（准备好做）：The team is poised to launch. 近义 composed（镇定的）；反义 flustered（慌乱的）。

essay.title: The Courage to Ask
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: I used to avoid asking questions in meetings, afraid the silence after would expose how little I knew. So I nodded, and noted in my head the things to look up later, alone, where no one could see the gap.

One day a senior colleague ventured a question so basic I had been certain only I did not know the answer. The room relaxed. Others chimed in with the same doubt, and the meeting suddenly became useful, because someone had admitted the obvious.

Since then I have tried to ask sooner, even when my voice shakes. A good question is not a confession of ignorance but an invitation: it tells the room that doubt is allowed here, and gives the quiet ones permission to speak.

The hardest part is still the pause before the words leave your mouth. But I have learned that most people are waiting for someone else to go first — and that the courage to ask is often just the willingness to be the first to look unsure.
translations: 从前我总在会上避免提问，怕问完那阵沉默会暴露我懂得太少。于是我点头，在心里记下那些待会儿独自去查的东西——在没人看得见漏洞的地方。
有一天，一位资深同事斗胆问了个极基础的问题——而我本以为只有我一个人不知道答案。屋子松了下来。别人也跟着接话，说出同样的疑惑，会议忽然有了用，因为有人坦白了那件明摆着的事。
从那以后，我试着早点问，哪怕声音发抖。好问题不是无知的坦白，而是一份邀请：它告诉屋里的人，这里允许有疑惑，也给安静的人开口的许可。
最难的仍是话出口前那一瞬的停顿。但我已懂得，大多数人都在等别人先开口——而提问的勇气，常常只是「愿意第一个显得没把握」罢了。

grammar.example: "afraid the silence after would expose how little I knew"
grammar.note: afraid 后接 that 引导的宾语从句（that 常省略），表示担心的内容；从句谓语 would expose 用过去将来时。 举一反三：She was afraid he would leave.

grammar.example: "a question so basic I had been certain only I did not know the answer"
grammar.note: so + 形容词 basic 后接 that 从句（that 省略）表结果；I had been certain 为嵌套的过去完成时宾语从句。 举一反三：It was so late that we left.

grammar.point: because 引导原因状语从句
grammar.note: because 引导原因状语从句；从句用过去完成时 had admitted，强调「坦白了」这一动作先于主句发生。 举一反三：He left because the train had gone.

vocab.note: 用法：avoid asking 避免提问；avoid the topic 避开话题。
用法：venture a question 斗胆发问；venture to say 冒昧地说。

vocab.enExample: He chimed in with a joke.
vocab.note: 用法：others chimed in 别人跟着接话。
用法：the same doubt 同样的疑惑；be in doubt 存疑。

vocab.enExample: The question was an invitation to reply.
vocab.note: 用法：an invitation to speak 开口的机会；引申为「招来」。
用法：admit the obvious 坦白明摆着的事；admit a mistake 认错。

vocab.enExample: I was ignorant of the rule.
vocab.note: 用法：a confession of ignorance 对无知的坦白；be ignorant of 不知。
用法：give permission to speak 给开口的许可。
用法：the willingness to go first 抢先开口的意愿。
用法：a confession of ignorance 坦承无知；confess a fear 坦白恐惧。
